prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ONLY TWO localized corrections to the supplied neutral Herdeiro Nórdico portrait.

1. Make the existing facial scar much more apparent and readable at small card size. On the LARGE eye on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE (the side closest to the visible ear and shaved temple), draw one clearly visible old healed diagonal scar running from just above that eyebrow, through the eyebrow and across that eye, continuing down onto the upper cheek where the existing scar marks are. Use a bold slightly irregular dark ink contour and a narrow warm-ivory scar strip with a few restrained side marks, keeping the game's simple carved-ink style. This should read as one coherent healed scar, not a tattoo, ordinary shading or fresh wound. No blood or gore.

2. The SAME eye crossed by this scar, on the viewer's RIGHT, must visibly be blind: keep its open eyelid shape but replace the black iris and pupil with an opaque milky warm-white / very pale neutral gray eye, with at most a faint small pale-gray iris outline and NO black pupil. It is a natural opaque blind eye, not glowing, magical, blue, luminous or covered by a patch. The OTHER eye on the viewer's LEFT stays exactly as it is, with its normal dark pupil.

Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE exactly: same man, facial anatomy, stern expression, original nose, mustache, long white hair swept back, shaved temple, double beard braids, gold earring, fur collar, tunic, gold fasteners, proportions, head coordinates, square canvas, bust crop, thick irregular black ink, economical hatching, warm-white #F9EEDD light palette and transparent alpha background. Do not redesign his face, clothes or hairstyle. No new props, background, border, text, halo or color shifts.
